name: ping
why: Preserve the supplied ping response.

name: dsu-empty
why: No vertices implies no operations or states.

name: dsu-repeated-self-mixed
why: A repeat or self union changes nothing; the final bridge merges sets sized three and two.

name: dsu-singleton
why: Self operations preserve one component and largest size one.

name: dsu-no-ops
why: Do not emit an initial state.

name: kruskal-empty
why: Zero vertices, zero components.

name: prim-empty
why: Zero vertices, zero components.

name: kruskal-isolates
why: All five vertices are isolated components.

name: prim-isolates
why: All five vertices are isolated components.

name: kruskal-parallel-negative-loop-disconnected
why: Select ids 1,2,4 with costs -3+2+1=0; ignore loop.

name: prim-parallel-negative-loop-disconnected
why: Select ids 1,2,4 with costs -3+2+1=0; ignore loop.

name: kruskal-equal-weight-triangle
why: Any two distinct triangle edges are optimal.

name: prim-equal-weight-triangle
why: Any two distinct triangle edges are optimal.

name: kruskal-large-positive
why: Four 10^9 edges require a 64-bit cost.

name: prim-large-positive
why: Four 10^9 edges require a 64-bit cost.

why: Three -10^9 edges require signed 64-bit.

name: prim-large-negative
why: Three -10^9 edges require signed 64-bit.

name: scc-empty
why: The empty graph has no SCCs.

name: scc-two-cycles-chain
why: The SCCs are {0,1}, {2,3}, {4} and cross-links only between adjacent groups.

name: scc-self-loops
why: Self-loops do not merge distinct vertices into SCCs.

name: scc-isolates
why: Each isolated vertex is a separate SCC.

name: scc-all-one
why: Cycle connects all vertices mutually.

name: topo-empty
why: Empty DAG has empty order.

name: topo-precedence
why: Each edge points forward in the listed valid topological order.

name: topo-isolates
why: All permutations of four isolated vertices are valid.

name: topo-cycle
why: A directed three-cycle makes ordering impossible.

name: topo-self
why: Self-loop is a directed cycle.

name: topo-parallel
why: Duplicate edges preserve acyclicity.

name: dag-singleton
why: Source is at distance zero with no parent.

name: dag-negative-unreachable
why: 0->1->2->3 costs 3-7+4=0, vertex 4 unreachable.

name: dag-minus-one-finite
why: Finite -1 differs from null unreachable.

name: dag-cycle-unreachable
why: The whole graph must be checked; component 2<->3 is cyclic.

name: dag-cycle-self
why: Unreachable self-loop must reject DAG.

name: dag-parallel-tied
why: Parallel 0->1 edges tied; path via 1 and direct 0->2 tied.

name: dag-source-nonzero
why: Source need not be zero; vertices 0 and 1 cannot be reached.

name: dag-64-bit
why: Four edges sum to 4e9, more than signed 32-bit integer.
